messages.content: Write one SYNTHETIC diplomatic utterance, not a quotation or reconstruction. Preserve ALL required conditions, numbers, actor roles, channel and commitment strength. Use generic we/you, not actual country names. A historical source only supplies discourse context. Do not copy unsupported historical details. Return an utterance under 65 words in a concise statement with a fronted condition or reordered clauses style.

{"source": "The Sudan and South Sudan should also respect the 2011 agreement and withdraw their military and police troops from the demilitarized zone.", "synthetic_required_meaning": "We will keep military forces outside the demilitarized zone for 3 weeks IF you keep police forces outside the demilitarized zone for 1 weeks. Our commitment depends on yours."}
